newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam output growth quickens in February.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam output growth quickens in February.

text.p: Vietnam's industrial output grew by an estimated 13.9 percent in February compared to the same month in 1996, the Statistics Office said on Friday.
The year-on-year rise in industrial output last month was estimated at 12.9 percent.

The Statistics Office said state sector output in February rose by 12.6 percent from February 1996, while non-state sector output was up 8.1 percent and output by the foreign-invested sector was up 22.5 percent.
